license_required.quote: no person may practice podiatry, designate himself or herself as a podiatrist, use or assume the title "doctor of surgical chiropody", "doctor of podiatry"or "doctor of podiatric medicine"... unless the person is licensed under this subchapter

issuing_authority.quote: the affiliated credentialing board shall grant a license as a podiatrist to a person

name.quote: "Affiliated credentialing board" means the podiatry affiliated credentialing board.

type.quote: "Affiliated credentialing board" means the podiatry affiliated credentialing board.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Safety and Professional Services
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of safety and professional services.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine or equivalent degree
degree_required.quote: the applicant is a graduate of a school of podiatric medicine and surgery approved by the affiliated credentialing board and possesses a diploma from such school conferring the degree of doctor of podiatric medicine, or equivalent degree as determined by the affiliated credentialing board

accrediting_body.quote: a school of podiatric medicine and surgery approved by the affiliated credentialing board

required.quote: the applicant has completed 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board

duration.value: 2 years (or 1 year if completed by June 1, 2010)
duration.quote: 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board or one year of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board if the one-year postgraduate training was completed by June 1, 2010

kind.quote: 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board

exams.name: Podiatrist licensure examination
exams.notes: Written or oral tests requiring demonstration of minimum competency in subjects substantially related to the practice of podiatry; conducted at least semiannually
exams.quote: An applicant who fails to pass an examination under this section may request reexamination, and may be reexamined not more than twice at not less than 4-month intervals

interval_years.quote: Podiatrist: November 1 of each even-numbered year.

required.quote: Proof of completion of continuing education requirements in s. 448.665.

available.quote: The affiliated credentialing board may waive the requirement under sub. (1) (d) 1. for an applicant who establishes... That he or she is licensed as a podiatrist by another licensing jurisdiction in the United States.

requirements.value: Applicant must be a graduate of a podiatry school, licensed as a podiatrist by another U.S. jurisdiction, the other jurisdiction required graduation from an approved or evaluated school, and the applicant has actively practiced podiatry under that license for at least 3 years immediately preceding the application date.
requirements.quote: The affiliated credentialing board may waive the requirement under sub. (1) (d) 1. for an applicant who establishes... That he or she has actively practiced podiatry, under the license issued by the other licensing jurisdiction in the United States, for at least 3 years immediately preceding the date of his or her application.

exists.quote: "Affiliated credentialing board" means the podiatry affiliated credentialing board.

regulatory_model.quote: no person may practice podiatry, designate himself or herself as a podiatrist... unless the person is licensed under this subchapter

credential_type.quote: the affiliated credentialing board shall grant a license as a podiatrist to a person

is_mandatory.quote: no person may practice podiatry, designate himself or herself as a podiatrist... unless the person is licensed under this subchapter

title_protection.quote: no person may... designate himself or herself as a podiatrist, use or assume the title "doctor of surgical chiropody", "doctor of podiatry"or "doctor of podiatric medicine"... unless the person is licensed under this subchapter

scope_protection.quote: no person may practice podiatry... unless the person is licensed under this subchapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acts or omissions constituting unprofessional conduct as defined by the affiliated credentialing board by rule, or acts by a podiatrist in violation of pharmacy or controlled substances law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: "Unprofessional conduct" means an act or attempted act of commission or omission, as defined by the affiliated credentialing board by rule under s. 448.695 (1), or an act by a podiatrist in violation of ch. 450 or 961.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving any fee, commission, rebate or other compensation for referring patients or for services not personally rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensee may give or receive, directly or indirectly, to or from any other person any fee, commission, rebate or other form of compensation or anything of value for sending, referring or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a licensee in a professional capacity, or for any professional services not actually rendered personally by the licensee or at the licensee's direction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to render individual statements of charges directly to patients as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a licensee who renders any podiatric service or assistance... shall... render an individual statement or account of the charge directly to the patient, distinct and separate from any statement or account by any other podiatrist
a person who practices podiatry without having a license under this subchapter may be liable for malpractice

definition_quote.value: "Podiatry" or "podiatric medicine and surgery" means that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle, but does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatry" or "podiatric medicine and surgery" means that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle, but does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II.

methods_authorized.quote: that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle

anesthesia_authority.quote: does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A person assisting a podiatrist in practice under the direct, on-premises supervision of the podiatrist.

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: A person assisting a podiatrist in practice under the direct, on-premises supervision of the podiatrist.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A physician assistant who is acting under the supervision and direction of a podiatrist, subject to s. 448.975 (2) (a) 2m.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is providing nonsurgical patient services as directed, supervised, and inspected by a podiatrist who has the power to direct, decide, and oversee the implementation of the patient services rendered.

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: Any person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II of ch. 448 or podiatry under subch. IV of ch. 448 shall be afforded an equal opportunity to obtain hospital staff privileges and may not be denied hospital staff privileges solely for the reason that the person is an osteopathic physician and surgeon or a podiatrist.
